Description: Install Nuxt UI and Tailwind CSS, then register the Nuxt module
Do: pnpm add @nuxt/ui tailwindcss and add @nuxt/ui to modules

Guideline: Import Tailwind and Nuxt UI CSS
Description: Required CSS imports in main.css file
Do: @import tailwindcss and @import @nuxt/ui

Description: UApp provides toast, tooltip, overlay, and locale context
Do: Wrap NuxtPage or RouterView once at the app root

Description: All Nuxt UI components use U prefix by default
Do: UButton UInput UModal

Description: Style Nuxt UI components with meaning-based colors such as primary, success, and error
Do: Use color props such as color="primary" or color="error"

Description: Nuxt UI provides solid outline soft subtle ghost link variants
Do: Choose a built-in variant before adding custom classes
Don't: Recreate a built-in variant with custom classes

Description: Components support xs sm md lg xl sizes
Do: size="sm" size="lg"

Description: Nuxt UI v4 uses Iconify i-prefix format — lucide:home is v3 legacy
Do: i-lucide-home i-heroicons-user format

Description: Position icons with dedicated props for clarity
Do: Use leadingIcon or trailingIcon for standard button icons
Don't: Build a custom icon slot when a standard icon prop is enough

Description: Runtime color configuration without restart
Do: ui.colors.primary in app.config.ts

Guideline: Define complete custom palettes with @theme static
Description: Nuxt UI custom colors require shades 50 through 950
Do: Define every --color-brand-* shade in @theme static
Don't: Define only one shade for a custom palette

Description: Register extra semantic color names at build time then map them to a palette in app.config
Do: nuxt.config ui.theme.colors plus app.config ui.colors

Description: UForm accepts Standard Schema libraries such as Zod, Valibot, Yup, and Joi
Do: Pass a Standard Schema with :schema and reactive state with :state

Description: Provides label error message and validation display
Do: UFormField with name prop

Description: UForm emits submit event with validated data
Do: @submit handler on UForm

Description: UForm validates on input blur and change by default; input is delayed and begins after blur unless eager
Do: Set validateOn and eager to match the interaction
Don't: Assume the default validates every keystroke immediately
Code Bad: Describe default UForm as eager input-only validation

Description: Modal Slideover Drawer use v-model:open
Do: v-model:open for controlled state

Guideline: Use useOverlay composable for programmatic overlays
Description: Open overlays programmatically — v4 API is create().open() not open(Component)
Do: Create the overlay once, then pass component props directly to open()
Code Good: const modal = overlay.create(MyModal); const { result } = modal.open({ title: 'Confirm' })

Description: Built-in header support for overlays
Do: Use title and description props for a standard overlay header
Don't: Rebuild a simple title and description with a custom header slot

Description: Provides collapsible resizable sidebar with mobile support
Do: UDashboardSidebar with header default footer slots

Description: Wraps dashboard components with sidebar state management
Do: UDashboardGroup > UDashboardSidebar + UDashboardPanel

Description: Responsive dashboard header with sidebar toggle and layout slots
Do: Place UDashboardNavbar in a UDashboardPanel header and use its slots for actions
Don't: Pass unsupported links props or rebuild the responsive toggle

Guideline: Use UTable with data and columns props
Description: Powered by TanStack Table with built-in features
Do: :data and :columns props

Description: Column definitions use accessorKey for data binding
Do: accessorKey: 'email' in column def

Description: Customize cell content with the documented column-id slot pattern
Do: #status-cell for a status column

Guideline: Enable sorting with TanStack column APIs
Description: Render a header control that calls column.toggleSorting
Do: Use getCanSort and toggleSorting
Don't: Invent a sortable property not in the column contract

Description: Horizontal or vertical navigation with dropdown support
Do: UNavigationMenu with items array

Description: Render accessible page hierarchy from an items array with NuxtLink support
Do: :items array with label and to

Description: Tab navigation with content panels
Do: UTabs with items containing slot content

Description: Composable notifications rendered by the UApp toast provider
Do: Wrap the app in UApp and call useToast().add()

Description: Static alert messages with icon and actions
Do: UAlert with title description color

Description: Placeholder content during data loading
Do: USkeleton with appropriate size

Description: Built-in light/dark mode toggle button
Do: UColorModeButton component

Description: Dropdown to select system light or dark mode
Do: UColorModeSelect component

Guideline: Use class for the root and ui for named slots
Description: class customizes the root slot; ui targets component slots
Do: Use class for root-only changes and ui after checking generated slot names
Don't: Use !important or guess undocumented slot names

Description: Set component default variants under ui component keys
Do: app.config ui.button.defaultVariants
Don't: Put button-specific defaults under global ui.theme.defaultVariants
Code Bad: ui: { theme: { defaultVariants: { variant: 'outline' } } } // affects every component

Description: Runtime theme customization
Do: defineAppConfig with ui key

Description: Generate CSS only for detected Nuxt UI components and their dependencies
Do: Use true for static usage or include dynamic component names in an array
Don't: Enable detection and omit components rendered through dynamic :is values

Guideline: Use UTable virtualize for large data
Description: Enable row virtualization when rendering large datasets
Do: Use the virtualize prop after row rendering becomes a measured bottleneck
Don't: Render a large dataset without pagination or virtualization

Guideline: Give overlays an accessible name and description
Description: Overlay title and description props provide dialog labeling
Do: Provide title and description unless custom slots supply equivalent semantics

Description: Use UFormField or correct native id and for attributes
Do: UFormField for convenience or explicit label association

Guideline: Use UContentToc for table of contents
Description: Automatic TOC with active heading highlight
Do: UContentToc with :links

Description: Command palette for documentation search
Do: UContentSearch with Nuxt Content

Description: Designed for Vercel AI SDK integration
Do: UChatMessages with messages array

Description: Enhanced textarea for AI prompts
Do: UChatPrompt with v-model

Description: TipTap-based editor binds its document with v-model
Do: UEditor with v-model

Description: UButton and ULink support NuxtLink to prop
Do: to="/dashboard" for internal links

Description: ULink and link-enabled components detect absolute URLs and support target when a new tab is intended
Do: to="https://example.com" target="_blank"
Don't: Use href inconsistently or claim an external prop is required

Description: Automatic loading state from @click promise
Do: loadingAuto prop on UButton

Description: Auto-disable form during submit
Do: loadingAuto on UForm (default true)

Guideline: Let Nuxt UI declare module dependencies
Description: Nuxt UI uses Nuxt moduleDependencies for Icon Fonts and Color Mode ordering and registration
Do: Configure dependency options at their root keys
Don't: Add duplicate module entries without a documented need

Guideline: Use official templates to bootstrap projects
Description: Create a Nuxt project from an official Nuxt UI template
Do: npm create nuxt@latest -- -t ui/dashboard
Code Bad: pnpm create nuxt app then copy dashboard files

Description: Install the Iconify JSON collections used by the app for reliable SSR and bundling
Do: pnpm i @iconify-json/lucide for lucide icons
Don't: Rely on an unavailable collection at runtime
Code Bad: Use i-custom-* without installing its collection

Guideline: Override default component icons centrally when needed
Description: appConfig.ui.icons keeps intentional icon overrides consistent
Do: Set a global icon key when the product needs a different default
Don't: Repeat the same icon override on every component instance

Description: Built-in drag-drop and preview support
Do: UFileUpload with v-model and accept prop

Description: Date input supports single dates and ranges with locale inherited from UApp
Do: Use range when needed and configure locale on UApp

Description: Multi-value tag input with keyboard support
Do: UInputTags with v-model and max prop

Description: Full-featured color picker with multiple format support
Do: UColorPicker with v-model and format prop

Description: Built-in tree component with expand/collapse
Do: UTree with items prop containing nested children

Guideline: Use UMarquee for infinite scroll content
Description: Animated infinite scroll band for logos or testimonials
Do: UMarquee with repeat and pauseOnHover props

Description: Context menu triggered by right-click on children
Do: UContextMenu wrapping target element

Guideline: Await overlay result for confirmation dialogs
Description: open() returns a Promise that resolves when the overlay component emits close
Do: Emit a close value from the overlay component and await modal.open()
Don't: Expect a result from a component that never emits close

Description: Command palette accepts groups with an id, label, and items
Do: Give every group a stable id and its own items
Don't: Pass a flat items prop that is not part of the component API

Description: Wire keyboard shortcuts from menu item kbds automatically
Do: extractShortcuts(items) + defineShortcuts to sync keybindings
Don't: Manually duplicate shortcuts from menu items
Code Bad: defineShortcuts({ meta_n: () => newFile() }) // duplicated from items

Guideline: Use UHeader and UFooter for page layout
Description: Responsive header/footer with built-in mobile menu
Do: UHeader with #default slot for nav UFooter with columns

Description: Sidebar that hides below lg breakpoint automatically
Do: UPageAside for docs and landing page sidebars

Guideline: Wrap custom color mode toggles in ClientOnly
Description: Prevents hydration mismatch on server-rendered color mode
Do: ClientOnly with fallback placeholder
Don't: Direct useColorMode in template without ClientOnly

Guideline: Read generated theme file to find slot names
Description: Generated theme files list current slots, variants, and default classes
Do: Check .nuxt/ui in Nuxt or node_modules/.nuxt-ui/ui in Vue before overriding slots
Don't: Guess slot names or use trial-and-error

Description: whenever array condition prevents shortcut firing when inactive
Do: whenever: [isFormValid] to guard shortcut execution
Don't: Always-on shortcuts that fire in wrong context
Code Bad: defineShortcuts({ meta_enter: () => submit() }) // fires even when invalid

Guideline: Use UApp locale prop for internationalization
Description: UApp locale configures component messages, formatting, and direction
Do: Pass a locale object to UApp and propagate lang and dir to html
Don't: Translate built-in component strings instance by instance

Guideline: Use USplitter for resizable panel layouts
Description: Splitter provides horizontal, vertical, nested, and collapsible resizable panels
Do: Define panel items with stable slots and size constraints
Don't: Reimplement drag resizing and keyboard behavior

Description: Generated ids and mixed default sizes can cause hydration mismatches or panel jumps
Do: Set id and give defaultSize to every item or to none; use auto-save-id for persistence
Don't: Mix items with and without defaultSize during SSR

Description: ProgressGroup displays multiple values as segments of one total with a legend
Do: Pass labeled items and an explicit max when the total is not 100
Don't: Build a segmented progress bar from unrelated div widths

Guideline: Retune library motion with theme easing tokens
Description: Nuxt UI 4.11 uses --ease-out for enter, exit, and movement transitions
Do: Override --ease-out in @theme to retime motion consistently
Don't: Override transition timing independently on every component

Guideline: Enable component detection in Vue and Vite
Description: The Nuxt UI Vite plugin can generate CSS only for detected components
Do: Set experimental.componentDetection in the @nuxt/ui/vite plugin and restart after adding components
Don't: Expect newly detected component styles without restarting the dev server
Code Bad: ui({}) // generates theme CSS for every component

Guideline: Use Nuxt UI 4.11+ for CommandPalette search
Description: Nuxt UI 4.11 escapes CommandPalette search highlights to prevent XSS
Do: Upgrade @nuxt/ui to 4.11.1 or newer when rendering untrusted command labels
Don't: Render untrusted CommandPalette labels with a pre-4.11 release
